deviations.reason: Hinge and squat rep-maxes 72 h apart (disc history, no back-to-back heavy lower days); run test not the day after a heavy squat; durability tests after strength (NSCA order).
No running in the last 4 weeks and a past left groin/hip injury: the only run this week is the submax test.
Keeps the week's running to the 40-min test while returning from zero.
Rebuilding deadlift confidence after two back episodes (latest 2026-06-03); a conservative first estimate.

rationale: Baseline week, reviewed against testing standards: power before strength; hinge and squat rep-maxes on separate days (disc history); trunk-endurance and grip tests fresh on their own day; a pace-locked treadmill submax run instead of the 30-min TT after 4 weeks of no running; a 10-min bike for the engine (low back load, repeatable).
focus_points: Rebuild hinge confidence: high-handle trap bar, RPE 8, stop at the first technique break or back discomfort > 2/10.

Weigh in every morning (scale -> Apple Health -> HealthFit -> Intervals.icu) for the 7-day body-comp baseline.
